sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Notice how the explanation names the reason for each step.

items.prompt: Output 10 at input 2, output 22 at input 5. Rate?

steps: Change in output 12, change in input 3.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: For f(x) = 2x² + 5x − 8, find the average rate of change from x = -4 to x = 2.
A sequence has g(1) = 6 and g(n) = 2·g(n − 1). Write the explicit form and find g(6).
A venue charges $75 to open plus $12 per attendee. Write C(n) for the total cost of n attendees, then find C(13).
Revenue is R(x) = -1x − 4 and cost is C(x) = 7x. Write the profit function P(x) = R(x) − C(x) in simplest form.

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Explain your method so that someone who has not done this unit could follow it.

items.prompt: A table records output 22 at input 4 and output 49 at input 6. What is the average rate of change between these readings?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: For f(x) = 4x² − 4x + 2, find the average rate of change from x = 3 to x = 6.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
